title: Legal Materials: Legislation
summary: Texts of legislation take the general form heading (Law--[place]) or topical legal headings, not the name of the act. Works about an individual act may take the name heading [jurisdiction]. [uniform title of law] (e.g. United States. Civil Rights Act of 1991) plus topical headings. Legislative histories: Legislative histories--[place] for general collections and works about technique; [legal topic]--[place]--Legislative history for topical collections; [act]--Legislative history plus topical headings with --Legislative history for an individual act.
validation_rules: General (non-topical) collections of legislation take the general form heading subdivided by place if limited to a jurisdiction, e.g. `Law--United States`. (H 1715 sec. 1.a)

Topical collections and individual acts take the topical legal heading(s) subdivided by place, e.g. `Agricultural laws and legislation--United States`, `Taxation--Law and legislation--United States`, `Marriage law--Argentina`, `Divorce--Law and legislation--Argentina`. (H 1715 sec. 1.b, 1.c)
Do not assign the heading for the name of an act to a work consisting solely of the text of the act. (H 1715 sec. 1.c)

Works discussing an individual act may take the name heading for the act in the form `[jurisdiction]. [uniform title of law]` (610 with $t), e.g. `United States. Civil Rights Act of 1991`, `United States. Tax Reform Act of 1986`, plus appropriate topical headings. (H 1715 sec. 2.b)

General collections of legislative histories, and works on techniques of compiling or using legislative histories, take `Legislative histories`, subdivided by place if appropriate, e.g. `Legislative histories--United States`, `Legislative histories--Ohio`. (H 1715 sec. 3.a, 3.d)

Collections of legislative histories on a topic take `[legal topic]--[place, if appropriate]--Legislative history` (free-floating), with `--Legislative history` after the place, e.g. `Abortion--Law and legislation--United States--Legislative history`. (H 1715 sec. 3.b)

The legislative history of an individual enactment takes `[name heading for the act]--Legislative history`, e.g. `United States. Black Lung Benefits Reform Act of 1977--Legislative history`, plus topical headings subdivided by `--Legislative history`, e.g. `Coal miners--Legal status, laws, etc.--United States--Legislative history`, `Budget--Law and legislation--Spain--País Vasco--Legislative history`. (H 1715 sec. 3.c)

sections.heading: a. General (non-topical) collections.
sections.text:
Assign the appropriate general form heading. Subdivide this heading by place if the collection is limited to a particular country, state, etc. Example:

```
Title: United States code.
650 #0 $a Law $z United States.
```

sections.heading: b. Topical collections.
sections.text:
Assign the appropriate topical heading(s), for example, Labor laws and legislation. Subdivide the heading by place if the collection is limited to a particular country, state, etc. Example:

```
Title: Compilation of laws relating to American agriculture.
650 #0 $a Agricultural laws and legislation $z United States.
```

sections.heading: c. Individual acts.
sections.text:
Assign the appropriate topical heading(s) in the same manner as for topical collections.

Do not assign the heading for the name of the act itself to a work that consists solely of the text of the act.

Examples:

```
Title: Technical Corrections Act of 1979.
650 #0 $a Taxation $x Law and legislation $z United States.

Title: Régimen de matrimonio civil y divorcio.
650 #0 $a Marriage law $z Argentina.
650 #0 $a Divorce $x Law and legislation $z Argentina.
```

sections.heading: a. Collective.
sections.text:
To works that discuss various laws related to a particular topic, assign the appropriate topical heading(s). Example:

```
Title: Environment '90 : the legislative agenda.
650 #0 $a Environmental law $z United States.
```

sections.heading: b. Individual acts.
sections.text:
Assign the heading for the name of the act to a work that discusses the law, if it is judged to be a useful access point. Establish these headings as name headings in accordance with RDA rules for headings for individual laws. These headings are normally in the form [jurisdiction]. [uniform title of law]. Also assign a topical heading or headings appropriate to the work being cataloged. Examples:

```
Title: Explanation of the Civil Rights Act of 1991.
610 10 $a United States. $t Civil Rights Act of 1991.
650 #0 $a Civil rights $z United States.
650 #0 $a Discrimination in employment $x Law and legislation $z United States.

Title: Taxing choices : the politics of tax reform.
610 10 $a United States. $t Tax Reform Act of 1986.
650 #0 $a Taxation $x Law and legislation $z United States.
```

sections.heading: 3. Legislative histories.
sections.text: Note: A legislative history is a collection of the texts of committee hearings, reports, floor debates, etc., leading up to the enactment of a law. Legislative histories are important, especially to courts, in determining the legislative intent of a particular statute.

sections.heading: a. General (non-topical) collections of legislative histories.
sections.text:
Assign the heading Legislative histories, subdivided by place if appropriate, to collections of legislative histories not limited to any specific topic. Example:

```
Title: American landmark legislation : primary materials.
650 #0 $a Law $z United States.
650 #0 $a Legislative histories $z United States.
```

sections.heading: b. Collections of legislative histories on a particular topic.
sections.text:
Assign the heading [legal topic] --[place, if appropriate], with the free-floating subdivision --Legislative history, to works that consist of the legislative histories of several enactments on a particular topic. Example:

```
Title: The legislative history of U.S. abortion laws.
650 #0 $a Abortion $x Law and legislation $z United States $x Legislative history.
```

sections.heading: c. Legislative history of an individual enactment.
sections.text:
Assign the name heading for the act subdivided by --Legislative history. Also assign the appropriate topical heading or headings subdivided by --Legislative history. Examples:

```
Title: Black Lung Benefits Reform act : a chronology of legislative actions.
610 10 $a United States. $t Black Lung Benefits Reform Act of 1977 $x Legislative history.
650 #0 $a Coal miners $x Legal status, laws, etc. $z United States $x Legislative history.

Title: Ley de régimen presupuestario de Euskadi : trabajos parlamentarios.
610 10 $a País Vasco (Spain). $t Euskadiko diruegitamuen jaurpideez Legea $x Legislative history.
650 #0 $a Budget $x Law and legislation $z Spain $z País Vasco $x Legislative history.
```

sections.heading: d. Works about legislative history.
sections.text:
Assign the heading Legislative histories, subdivided by place if appropriate, to works that discuss the techniques for compiling or using legislative histories. Examples:

```
Title: A guide to legislative history in Ohio.
650 #0 $a Legislative histories $z Ohio.

Title: Using and misusing legislative history : a re-evaluation of the status of legislative history in statutory interpretation.
650 #0 $a Legislative histories $z United States.
```
